subject: AtlasHealth: Azure private plan - MPA amendment & co-sell evidence
messages:
From: Sara Kline <sara.kline@atlashealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasHealth - Azure private plan: contract redlines & co-sell evidence

Hi Jonas / Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Procurement and legal reviewed the private plan paperwork and attached their redlines (Atlas_Redlines_v2.docx). High-level asks from our side: 

- Data residency & audit scope: a clause to guarantee EU/US data separation for customer datasets and a 30-day window for audit log export.
- Billing & entitlement routing: procurement needs an explicit invoice path and PO flow for Azure marketplace private SKUs.
- Co-sell and MPA linkage: legal says we need written confirmation that Redwood will provide co-sell evidence (MPA references + sales handoff email) prior to go-live; they want an amendment to the MPA to clarify timelines.

Can you confirm which of the redlines are negotiable and whether you can provide the co-sell evidence packet by the time we sign? We also need to know if Redwood can accept a 60-day invoice net from the marketplace billing (Atlas prefers 60).

Attached: Atlas_Redlines_v2.docx

Looking forward to your response — procurement would like to close contractual terms this week if possible.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kline
Sr. Procurement Manager
AtlasHealth

----

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@atlashealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth - Azure private plan: contract redlines & co-sell evidence

Sara — thanks for sending. We reviewed the redlines quickly and want to propose a short internal sync to align on what we can accept and what will require MPA amendment conversation with Microsoft. Quick answers up front: 

- Data residency / audit logs: we can guarantee US/EU partitioning for customer data stored on Redwood Private, and we can commit to a 30-day export window for audit logs. We will provide the language for the DPA that reflects this.
- Billing routing: Azure private SKUs require the seller to configure invoice routing via the marketplace entitlement flow. We can provide an entitlement routing playbook and nominate our billing contact to work with procurement.
- Co-sell evidence: we can produce the co-sell packet (MPA reference + partner handoff email + win plan) but the specific MPA amendment text needs coordination with Microsoft — that may take 3–5 business days to finalize.

Irene / Marissa — can you review the attached redlines and suggest fallback language for sections highlighted in the doc (esp. sections 4.2 and 7.1 on audit & liabilities)? If we can get a targeted redline back by EOD today, I will send a countersigned path to Sara and include a draft MPA amendment for MS.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call today at 4pm PT to align (if that works for procurement).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Phones: +1 (415) 555-0123

----

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth - Azure private plan: contract redlines & co-sell evidence

Folks — I reviewed Atlas' redlines. Summary and suggested positions below (keeping negotiation posture tight to avoid SLA/indemnity creep):

1) Data residency & audit logs (Section 4.2): Acceptable to commit to logical partitioning and 30-day export. Recommend wording: "Redwood will maintain logical separation of AtlasHealth customer data and provide audit log exports on request within 30 days."

2) Liability / indemnity (Section 7.1): Atlas asks to expand carve-outs. Recommend we keep indemnity limited to IP infringement and gross negligence; push back on broad commercial loss coverage.

3) Billing & entitlements: Procurement wants PO + 60-day net. Marketplace flow: we can accept 60 days for invoices issued by Redwood directly, but if Azure invoicing flow intermediates the marketplace, the net terms are governed by Azure's merchant agreement — flag this as a Microsoft dependency.

4) MPA amendment / co-sell evidence: We can commit to producing the co-sell packet and a partner reference to the MPA, but any binding amendment to the MPA that changes Microsoft revenue share or co-sell handoff timelines requires MS approval. Action: Jonas to engage azure-marketplace@microsoft.com and request expedited MPA amendment review.

I've drafted fallback language; attaching suggested snippets inline below (Irene please pull into a countersigned doc).

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
----

From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@atlashealth.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, azure-marketplace@microsoft.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth - Azure private plan: contract redlines & co-sell evidence

Sara / Jonas — attached is a proposed countersign path and a redline summary (MPA_Amendment_draft.pdf). For transparency I've included a short table here of accepted vs outstanding items: 

Accepted: 
- Logical data residency and 30-day export window (Section 4.2)
- Entitlement routing playbook and nominated billing contact

Outstanding / MS dependency: 
- Explicit marketplace invoice net-term guarantee when Azure acts as the billing intermediary (procurement requested 60 days) — dependent on Azure merchant terms.
- Any changes to MPA economics or revenue share; MS sign-off required.

We propose this approach: Redwood will sign the private plan and the DPA with the data residency and audit language. Atlas procurement can raise the 60-day net request; we will escalate to Azure ops to confirm merchant billing terms. Separately, Redwood will prepare a co-sell evidence packet and request an MPA amendment with Azure; we will seek a 3–5 business day review from Microsoft.

Attachments: MPA_Amendment_draft.pdf (proposed amendment language), countersign_instructions.txt (embedded in doc)

If that sounds OK, Jonas — please confirm and we'll send the countersigned draft to Atlas Legal for final pass.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
----

From: Cale Evans <calevans@atlashealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Kline <sara.kline@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth - Azure private plan: contract redlines & co-sell evidence

Irene — thanks for the quick draft. A couple of clarifying points from Atlas Legal/Procurement: 

1) Net terms: Atlas' standard is 60 days. If Azure intermediates invoicing and prevents Redwood from guaranteeing 60 days, we need an explicit statement in the contract that Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to align invoice timing and provide an exception mechanism (PO-based reconciliation).

2) Audit access: the 30-day export window is acceptable; we also want an SLA to acknowledge Redwood will respond to an audit evidence request within 5 business days to confirm availability of the export.

3) Co-sell evidence: Atlas requires the co-sell packet and a documented partner MPA reference before onboarding to our sales ops. If Microsoft needs time, can Redwood provide a provisional handoff certificate signed by Redwood plus a plan of record? Procurement needs the handoff to close their internal buy process.

Can you provide the countersigned private plan and the proposed co-sell packet by EOD Thursday (2027-03-04)? That will allow our procurement team to route the PO.

Regards,
Cale Evans
Sr. Counsel & Procurement Liaison
AtlasHealth
----

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kline <sara.kline@atlashealth.com>, Cale Evans <calevans@atlashealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, azure-marketplace@microsoft.com, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth - Azure private plan: contract redlines & co-sell evidence

Hi Cale / Sara — thanks for the notes and for the clear asks. Quick status and commitments: 

- Countersigned private plan: Attached is the countersigned private plan for Atlas (signed by Redwood) and the DPA language reflecting the 30-day audit export window. See attachment: MPA_Amendment_draft.pdf (included for MS review).
- Net terms: We cannot unilaterally change Azure merchant invoicing terms. That said, Redwood will accept 60-day net for invoices Redwood issues directly. If Azure intermediates billing, we will work with Azure ops (cc'd) and Atlas procurement to configure PO reconciliation logic.
- Audit SLA: Redwood will confirm availability of audit exports within 5 business days of request; this will be stated in the countersigned DPA.
- Co-sell evidence & provisional handoff: We are assembling the co-sell packet now (MPA reference, opportunity handoff email, GTM plan); we will provide a provisional handoff certificate signed by Redwood by EOD tomorrow and will follow up with the MS MPA amendment progress.

Next steps: 
1) Atlas: please confirm acceptance of the countersigned private plan PDF attached.
2) Azure marketplace (cc): please confirm the expected timeline to review the attached amendment language and confirm whether the marketplace billing will permit 60-day net when the seller (Redwood) requests it.
3) Redwood Finance (Sean): please prioritize invoice routing doc and an outline of how we will handle PO reconciliation if Azure invoices directly.

I'll follow up with the co-sell packet by EOD tomorrow; aiming to have procurement PO routed next week.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Attachment(s): MPA_Amendment_draft.pdf
